verdict.rationale: cubic supports natural-language interactions such as commenting '@cubic-dev-ai review this PR', replying to review comments for clarification, asking chat to 'tour this PR', and connecting via MCP so agents can query review findings — all NL-driven interfaces. However, this is chat/comment-based NL within PR/IDE contexts rather than a general NL command interface for the full product surface (e.g., config, analytics, wiki management still require YAML/dashboard, not NL commands). missing for 10: evidence of NL commands controlling broader product actions (analytics, admin, wiki generation) and independent hands-on confirmation of NL command reliability.
